full_judgment: “A newspaper or journal, etc. etc. Though a presumption of genuineness attaches under this section to a document purporting to be a newspaper or journal, it cannot be treated as proof of the facts reported therein. We cannot take judicial notice of the facts stated in the news item being in the nature of hearsay secondary evidence, unless proved by evidence aliunde. A report in a newspaper or magazine is only hearsay evidence. It is not one of the documents referred to in section 78(2) of the Evidence Act by which an allegation of fact can be proved.”
